description: The local windows: the main one (`home`, the editor's shell on a folder of this computer) and each folder's or document's (`files-*`), local content served from the app's own bundle. They may call what their shell and its This device view call: this computer's recent places and pointing a window at another, the account's sandboxes as the workspace last listed them and the way to them, and the machine's sandboxes, agent, Docker engine, setups and syncs. The documents they draw can call none of it: the page's policy runs no script but the bundle's own (vite.local.config.ts), frames a document opens are other origins with no capability, and a link from a local window is heard only as `window` or `local` (setup_link.rs). The workspace is remote content and gets nothing at all: its only channel into the app is the intentic:// navigation the window handler intercepts. `set-title` is the main window's, whose title says a setup is running there (src/device/title.ts): the one sign of it outside the process. Every command of the app's own is a permission granted here by name (build.rs).
